resources.name: Certificate Transparency
quotes: The primary dataset used for measuring third-party stale certificates is Certificate Transparency (CT), which is a set of log servers that, in aggregate, publishes all TLS certificates trusted by Google Chrome and Apple Safari.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors used Certificate Transparency logs as their primary dataset to collect and analyze 5 billion TLS certificates.

resources.name: Centralized Zone Data Service (CZDS)
quotes: We first extracted the domains from all publicly available zone files from the Centralized Zone Data Service (CZDS) [1], which includes the popular org, com, and net zones.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors used CZDS to extract domains from publicly available zone files for their DNS scanning experiments.

resources.name: AVClass2
quotes: We used AVClass2 [66] to identify malware families and manually inspected the resulting malware family labels and resolved aliases using Malpedia [ 64].
references: [66] Silvia Sebastián and Juan Caballero. 2020. AVclass2: Massive Malware Tag Extraction from AV Labels. In Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC).
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The authors used AVClass2 to identify malware families associated with domains found to have stale certificates.
